environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, proxy integration). CloudFront distribution configured with Response Headers Policy ID 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03 (a custom policy). This policy appends a Content-Security-Policy response header with directive: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; with require-sri-for script. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has an Origin Request Policy that strips Transfer-Encoding headers from viewer requests before forwarding to origin (custom ORP based on Managed-AllViewerExceptHostHeader but with Transfer-Encoding added to the headers blacklist). The API Gateway resource has a request validator (ValidateBody) attached to the /render POST method that enforces the request model schema requiring analytics_src to match pattern ^https://cdn\.example\.com/.*$. Note: the request body passthrough behavior is set to WHEN_NO_MATCH so unmodeled content types still pass through.

config.api_gateway: REST API, proxy integration, request validator 'ValidateBody' on POST /render with model requiring analytics_src matches ^https://cdn\.example\.com/.*$, passthrough behavior WHEN_NO_MATCH
config.cloudfront_response_headers_policy: custom policy 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03, adds Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; require-sri-for script
config.cloudfront_origin_request_policy: custom ORP based on Managed-AllViewerExceptHostHeader with Transfer-Encoding in headers blacklist
